title: Footwork
subtitle: 步法、移動、踏步技巧、站位——究竟是哪一種 footwork？
description: 步法、移動、踏步技巧、站位——究竟是哪一種 footwork？

words.note: 最廣泛、最中性的說法。表示身體或腳如何移動，但不一定強調技術細節。

exercises.original: Her footwork around the tennis court was smooth and economical.
exercises.zh: 她在網球場上的移動流暢而有效率。
exercises.upgrade: Her movement around the tennis court was smooth and economical.

options.explanation: — 最中性地描述她在球場上的整體移動。
— 強調站姿練習，不是整體移動。
— 只強調每一步腳落的位置。

exercises.original: The coach wanted his footwork to become more relaxed and natural.
exercises.zh: 教練希望他的移動變得更放鬆、更自然。
exercises.upgrade: The coach wanted his movement to become more relaxed and natural.

options.explanation: — 是身體各部分的配合能力。
— 這裡泛指整體移動方式。

words.note: 表示腳步移動的方法和技術，特別強調怎樣踏步、移步或換步才正確。

exercises.original: The instructor corrected her footwork before increasing the speed of the drill.
exercises.zh: 導師在提高訓練速度前先糾正她的踏步技巧。
exercises.upgrade: The instructor corrected her stepping technique before increasing the speed of the drill.

options.explanation: — 強調如何正確踏步、換步。
— 是配合能力，不是具體步法。

exercises.original: Beginners should learn the correct footwork before attempting faster combinations.
exercises.zh: 初學者應先學正確踏步技巧，之後才嘗試更快的組合。
exercises.upgrade: Beginners should learn the correct stepping technique before attempting faster combinations.

words.note: 表示每一步腳應放在哪裡，重點是腳的位置準確性。

exercises.original: On the narrow beam, precise footwork was essential to avoid slipping.
exercises.zh: 在狹窄平衡木上，準確的腳位對避免滑倒非常重要。
exercises.upgrade: On the narrow beam, precise foot placement was essential to avoid slipping.

options.explanation: — 重點是每一步腳落在哪裡。

exercises.original: The climbing coach told him to improve his footwork on small holds.
exercises.zh: 攀石教練叫他改善在細小支點上的腳位。
exercises.upgrade: The climbing coach told him to improve his foot placement on small holds.

options.explanation: — 攀石時重點正是腳放在支點的準確位置。
— 是活動範圍和移動能力。
— 指整體站位，不是腳落點。

words.note: 表示身體或雙腳相對於對手、球、舞台或空間的位置安排。重點是站在哪裡最有利。

exercises.original: His defensive footwork kept him between the attacker and the goal.
exercises.zh: 他的防守站位令自己一直保持在進攻者和球門之間。
exercises.upgrade: His defensive positioning kept him between the attacker and the goal.

exercises.original: Good footwork allowed the goalkeeper to stay in the best place before each shot.
exercises.zh: 良好的站位令守門員在每次射門前都能保持最佳位置。
exercises.upgrade: Good positioning allowed the goalkeeper to stay in the best place before each shot.

options.explanation: — 明確強調「處於最佳位置」。
— 是移動能力，不等於站位。

words.note: 表示維持、調整或切換站姿的技巧，常見於拳擊、武術、擊劍和其他需要穩定架勢的運動。

exercises.original: The boxer spent the first part of training on basic footwork and stable fighting positions.
exercises.zh: 拳手在訓練初段集中練習基本站姿和穩定架勢。
exercises.upgrade: The boxer spent the first part of training on basic stance work.

options.explanation: — 強調建立和維持穩定架勢。

exercises.original: Before learning kicks, students practised footwork that helped them maintain a stable martial-arts stance.
exercises.zh: 學生在學踢腿前先練習能保持穩定武術架勢的站姿控制。
exercises.upgrade: Before learning kicks, students practised stance work.

options.explanation: — 可以是固定移動模式，但這裡重點是架勢穩定。

words.note: 表示一個人在空間中自由、有效地移動的能力。比 movement 更強調能否靈活到達不同位置。

exercises.original: Better footwork helped the defender cover a much larger area of the court.
exercises.zh: 更好的移動能力令防守球員可以覆蓋更大的球場範圍。
exercises.upgrade: Better mobility helped the defender cover a much larger area of the court.

options.explanation: — 強調能有效移動到不同位置。

exercises.original: The rehabilitation programme improved her footwork enough for her to move freely again.
exercises.zh: 復康計劃改善了她的移動能力，令她再次可以自由活動。
exercises.upgrade: The rehabilitation programme improved her mobility enough for her to move freely again.

options.explanation: — move freely 是最明顯線索。

words.note: 表示快速改變方向、速度或身體位置的能力。重點是快、靈活、反應迅速。
words.example: 這個 footwork 是否特別強調快速變向和敏捷反應？

exercises.original: Quick footwork allowed her to change direction immediately when the shuttle moved behind her.
exercises.zh: 敏捷的步法令她在羽毛球飛到身後時可以立即變向。
exercises.upgrade: Her agility allowed her to change direction immediately when the shuttle moved behind her.

options.explanation: — change direction immediately 直接指敏捷變向。

exercises.original: The coach used cone drills to improve the players' footwork when changing direction at speed.
exercises.zh: 教練利用雪糕筒訓練提升球員高速變向時的敏捷性。
exercises.upgrade: The coach used cone drills to improve the players' agility.

options.explanation: — 高速變向正是 agility 的核心。
— 能移動，但不特別表示快速變向。
— 只是其中一個技術因素。

words.note: 表示一組重複或有規律的移動方式，例如前進、後退、側移或特定運動中的固定步法模式。

exercises.original: The same footwork was repeated every time the player moved from the centre to the corner.
exercises.zh: 球員每次由中央移到角位時，都重複同一套移動模式。
exercises.upgrade: The same movement pattern was repeated every time the player moved from the centre to the corner.

options.explanation: — 重複出現的移動方式最符合。

exercises.original: Analysts studied his footwork to identify habits that opponents could predict.
exercises.zh: 分析員研究他的移動模式，以找出對手可以預測的習慣。
exercises.upgrade: Analysts studied his movement pattern to identify habits that opponents could predict.

options.explanation: — 可預測、重複的習慣正是 movement pattern。
— 需要固定順序，比這裡更具體。

words.note: 表示一連串按照特定次序完成的步伐，特別常見於舞蹈、體操、武術套路和技術訓練。

exercises.original: The dancer practised the footwork one section at a time until she remembered every step.
exercises.zh: 舞者逐段練習步序，直至記住每一個步伐。
exercises.upgrade: The dancer practised the step sequence one section at a time until she remembered every step.

options.explanation: — 需要記住一連串固定步伐。

exercises.original: The martial-arts routine contains a difficult section of footwork with six steps in a fixed order.
exercises.zh: 這套武術套路包含一段困難步序，六個步伐需要按照固定次序完成。
exercises.upgrade: The martial-arts routine contains a difficult step sequence with six steps in a fixed order.

words.note: 較正式、技術性的詞，表示身體從一個位置移到另一個位置的方式。常見於運動科學、生物力學、復康和動作研究。

exercises.original: Researchers used motion sensors to analyse the athlete's footwork during acceleration.
exercises.zh: 研究人員利用動作感應器分析運動員加速時的身體移動方式。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers used motion sensors to analyse the athlete's locomotion during acceleration.

options.explanation: — 科學研究中分析身體位移方式，很適合。

exercises.original: The rehabilitation study compared normal footwork with movement after ankle injury.
exercises.zh: 復康研究比較正常移動方式與腳踝受傷後的移動方式。
exercises.upgrade: The rehabilitation study compared normal locomotion with movement after ankle injury.

options.explanation: — 可以分析模式，但這裡是整體移動方式的研究。
— 運動科學／復康語境非常適合。

words.note: 表示在移動、停步、轉向或受力時保持身體穩定的能力。它是良好 footwork 的核心組成部分之一。

exercises.original: Her footwork improved because she could stop suddenly without losing stability.
exercises.zh: 她的步法改善了，因為她能突然停下而不失去平衡。
exercises.upgrade: Her balance control improved because she could stop suddenly without losing stability.

options.explanation: — without losing stability 明確指平衡控制。
— 可能有幫助，但不是核心。
— 可快速停下，但題目特別強調穩定。

exercises.original: The coach focused on footwork that helped the athlete remain stable after landing.
exercises.zh: 教練集中訓練令運動員落地後保持穩定的平衡控制。
exercises.upgrade: The coach focused on balance control after landing.

options.explanation: — remain stable after landing 是核心。

words.note: 表示向前、向後、側面或斜向移動的技術，重點在不同方向之間的控制和切換。

exercises.original: The drill improved footwork when players moved forward, backward, and sideways.
exercises.zh: 這項訓練改善球員向前、向後和側向移動的方向控制。
exercises.upgrade: The drill improved directional movement when players moved forward, backward, and sideways.

options.explanation: — 前、後、側向是最清楚線索。

exercises.original: Good footwork allowed the boxer to move diagonally away from the ropes.
exercises.zh: 良好的方向性移動令拳手可以斜向離開圍繩位置。
exercises.upgrade: Good directional movement allowed the boxer to move diagonally away from the ropes.

options.explanation: — 結果可能改善位置，但題目重點是如何移動。

words.note: 表示身體重量由一隻腳轉移到另一隻腳，常見於拳擊、網球、高爾夫、舞蹈和武術。
words.example: 這個 footwork 是否特別涉及身體重量在雙腳之間的轉移？

exercises.original: His footwork became more powerful when he learned to move his body weight smoothly from the back foot to the front foot.
exercises.zh: 當他學會把身體重量由後腳順暢轉移到前腳後，動作變得更有力量。
exercises.upgrade: His weight transfer became smoother when he learned to move his body weight from the back foot to the front foot.

options.explanation: — 題目直接描述重量由後腳轉到前腳。

exercises.original: The tennis coach adjusted her footwork so that more force moved through the shot.
exercises.zh: 網球教練調整她的重心轉移，令擊球能產生更大的力量。
exercises.upgrade: The tennis coach adjusted her weight transfer so that more force moved through the shot.

options.explanation: — 重心轉移直接影響力量傳遞。
— 腳位可能影響，但不是主要概念。

words.meaning: 協調性；腳步與身體配合
words.note: 表示腳、腿、軀幹、手臂和視覺之間能否配合順暢。重點是不同身體部分同步工作。

exercises.original: Ladder drills improved her footwork by helping her feet and upper body move together more smoothly.
exercises.zh: 繩梯訓練改善她的協調性，令雙腳和上半身配合得更流暢。
exercises.upgrade: Ladder drills improved her coordination by helping her feet and upper body move together more smoothly.

options.explanation: — feet and upper body move together 是關鍵。

exercises.original: The beginner's footwork looked awkward because his arms and legs were not working together.
exercises.zh: 初學者的步法看起來很生硬，因為手腳未能協調配合。
exercises.upgrade: The beginner lacked coordination because his arms and legs were not working together.

options.explanation: — 不一定是速度或變向問題。
— 手腳未能一起工作，正是協調問題。

falseSynonyms.zh: 步法技術不等於所有移動 Movement 是很廣的詞，可以包括手、軀幹或整個身體；footwork 特別聚焦腳步和位置控制。
falseSynonyms.point: Her overall movement was smooth. Her footwork helped her stay balanced while changing direction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 步法不等於敏捷性 Footwork 是具體腳步技術；agility 是快速變向和反應的能力。
falseSynonyms.point: Good footwork keeps the feet in effective positions. Good agility helps an athlete change direction quickly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 腳落點不等於整體站位 Foot placement 是腳本身放在哪裡；positioning 是整個身體相對於對手、球或空間的位置。
falseSynonyms.point: Correct foot placement prevents slipping. Good positioning keeps the defender between the attacker and the goal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 站姿不等於移動中的步法 Stance 是某一刻的站立姿勢；footwork 包括由一個位置移到另一個位置的腳步控制。
falseSynonyms.point: His boxing stance was stable. His boxing footwork allowed him to move in and out quickly.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可移動不等於快速變向 Mobility 強調移動範圍和自由度；agility 強調快速、靈活地改變方向。
falseSynonyms.point: Good hip mobility allows a wider range of movement. Good agility allows faster changes of direction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 固定步序不等於整體移動模式 Step sequence 是按特定次序的一串步伐；movement pattern 可以更廣泛，包括方向、節奏和身體位置。
falseSynonyms.point: The dancer memorised the step sequence. The coach analysed the player's repeated movement pattern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 保持穩定不等於轉移重心 Balance 是維持穩定；weight transfer 是把身體重量由一隻腳移到另一隻腳。
falseSynonyms.point: She maintained her balance after landing. She used efficient weight transfer during the stroke.

falseSynonyms.zh: 協調能力不等於技術本身 Coordination 是身體不同部分能否配合；technique 是完成動作的方法和技巧。
falseSynonyms.point: The drill improved his coordination. The coach corrected his stepping technique.
